brief:
The deaths of nine American citizens in the occupied West Bank over the past two years raise questions about US diplomatic presence in Jerusalem and its role in the region, Al Jazeera English reported. The killings occurred amid escalating tensions between Israeli forces and Palestinians, with circumstances surrounding each death varying.

Details about individual cases and the specific contexts of these deaths were not detailed in the available reporting. The question of how US Embassy operations in Jerusalem relate to American safety in the West Bank remained unresolved.
dek: What led to the deaths of the nine Americans killed in the occupied West Bank since 2022?
title: Nine Americans killed in occupied West Bank since 2022
